rotation.title: Rotate views
rotation.hint: The stage moves on to the next view by itself, each one for the time you choose (30 seconds by default), on the projection and in class mode. You can also edit it from the views menu in class mode and on the projection. If you pick a view that is not on the list by hand, or turn on the calm screen, it stops until you show one from the list again.

help.title: Help
help.step1: Open “Templates” and load one, or type the activities into the schedule.
help.step2: Press “Open projection”, drag the window to the whiteboard and double-click it for full screen. With a single screen, use “Class mode”.
help.step3: Press “Start” and move on with the right arrow or a presentation remote.
help.step4: Everything can be edited live: the projection updates instantly.
help.shortcutsHelp: They work in the panel, in class mode and in the projection window. Presentation remotes are supported.
help.aboutText: pictapp helps structure the session in a visual, predictable way on the interactive whiteboard. It is designed especially for autistic students, but applies to the whole group (Universal Design for Learning): it never singles anyone out.
help.privacy: No accounts and no server. Data is stored only in this browser and the app works offline.
help.font: Atkinson Hyperlegible typeface (Braille Institute, SIL Open Font License).

layout.hint: Make the “Now → Next” band or the notices band smaller so the stage (e.g. the timer) looks bigger. You can also drag the handles on the preview or move them with the arrow keys. Both can be hidden; if you hide the bottom one, transition notices are not shown.

turns.help: Shows whose turn it is now and next, in a fixed, visible order. When turns are on screen, the arrow keys move to the next turn.

substitute.title: Today we have a substitute teacher
substitute.p1: Sometimes our teacher cannot come to class.
substitute.p2: Then another teacher comes. They are called a substitute teacher.
substitute.p3: At first, it may feel strange. That is normal.
substitute.p4: Today's agenda is still on the board.
substitute.p5: We can listen to the substitute and ask if we have questions.
substitute.p6: Another day, our teacher will come back.

fireDrill.title: Fire drill
fireDrill.p1: Today we will have a fire drill. It is a practice: there is no fire.
fireDrill.p2: A loud alarm will ring for a while.
fireDrill.p3: The noise may bother us. We can cover our ears.
fireDrill.p4: We walk out in a line, with the group and the teacher.
fireDrill.p5: We wait together at the meeting point until we are told we can go back.
fireDrill.p6: Then we go back to class and continue the agenda.

outing.title: We are going on a trip
outing.p1: Today we are going on a trip outside school.
outing.p2: We will go by bus, with the whole group.
outing.p3: There may be more people and more noise than in class.
outing.p4: We stay close to the group and the teacher.
outing.p5: At the end, we will come back to school.
